description: This PHP source file defines a RESTful API endpoint class 'VacancyAttachmentAPI' for managing vacancy attachment resources within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting vacancy attachments, with associated validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing vacancy attachments in the recruitment module, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval with appropriate validation and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Method intended to retrieve all vacancy attachments but currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll endpoint, not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new vacancy attachment, including parsing request data, validation, and saving the attachment.

methods.name: setVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Sets the vacancy attachment entity's properties from request parameters.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment content from a base64 encoded payload.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create endpoint.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the attachment payload.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns common validation rules for request body parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes vacancy attachments based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete endpoint.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Internal method to fetch attachments and count for a given vacancy ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching a specific vacancy's attachments.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing vacancy attachment; possibly replacing current file content.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for update operation.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Converts a VacancyAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for API responses.
